name: omnibill/afnor
description: Omnibill AFNOR: an approved platform (plateforme agréée) through the standard API of XP Z12-013 - the Flow Service (submit an invoice, a lifecycle status or an e-reporting file, follow its acknowledgement, receive suppliers' invoices and statuses, webhooks with their signature checked) and the Directory Service (where a SIREN or a SIRET receives); any platform that implements the standard, by its address.
